milestones.title: Control-plane admin acceptance
milestones.goal: Finish and verify the control-plane admin write path without regressing the current uncommitted admin/control-plane work.
acceptance: Tenant and domain write paths are coherent with the canonical schema.
The admin slice stays fail-closed when the control-plane DB is unavailable or incomplete.
Verification notes or commands for the slice are captured in repo docs if behavior changed.

milestones.title: Shared storefront two-tenant acceptance
milestones.goal: Push the shared storefront from host-resolution scaffolding to the P2 acceptance gate for two distinct tenants.
acceptance: Two tenant hosts render distinctly from the same runtime.
Tenant resolution stays fail-closed on unknown or invalid hosts.
The repo includes a reliable verification path for the shared runtime proof.

Tenant config has a concrete path to Medusa sales-channel and publishable-key usage.
Docs state what remains stubbed before real checkout.
